code:
# CIS Azure Foundations 1.1
# "Ensure MFA is enabled for all privileged users"
#  - Rationale:   privileged accounts are the highest-value target
#  - Audit:       check Entra ID security defaults / Conditional Access
#  - Remediation: enable a Conditional Access policy requiring MFA
#
# CIS AWS Foundations 1.5
# "Ensure MFA is enabled for the 'root' user account"
#  - Rationale:   root is the single most powerful AWS identity
#  - Audit:       aws iam get-account-summary
#  - Remediation: attach a hardware/virtual MFA device to root
